title: Haiti PM praises Bukele after Salvadoran troops help destroy gang headquarters
summary: Haitian Prime Minister Alix Didier Fils-Aime praised Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele on Tuesday after Salvadoran troops destroyed a suspected gang leader’s home.
